summary:
Do new, fuel efficient vessels still make sense in lower
bunker price environments? Everyone in the tanker industry is aware of the recent drop in crude oil prices and the decline in bunker fuel prices that followed. Bunker fuel is the single most expensive cost in operating tankers, so this is a welcome relief for ship owners.
